dish.note: Cola over ice with cherry syrup and a squeeze of lime, Mel's way. Toad orders big.
dish.how: Stir 1 tbsp cherry syrup (or the juice from a jar of maraschino cherries) into each of 4 tall glasses of ice. Top with cold cola, squeeze in a lime wedge and drop in a cherry.
dish.make_ahead: Chill the cola well; pour to order

steps.text: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and stir 1 tbsp cherry syrup from the jar into each.
Top with cold cola, squeeze in a lime wedge and drop in a cherry.
